categories.main_business_segments: The company operates as a digital technology cloud service provider focused on new digital infrastructure. Main business segments include: (1) Intelligent software and hardware business (digital cloud infrastructure) - comprising self-developed software/hardware products, platform sales, and cloud services; (2) Digital intelligent services - including BIM/CIM digital intelligent services, digital platform customization development, and overall solutions for industry clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and BIM (Building Information Modeling) technologies. Core methods include: self-developed software and hardware products with IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) capabilities, cloud-based collaborative platforms for engineering projects, digital transformation solutions combining software and hardware, and intelligent server design and manufacturing. The company has obtained 169 software copyrights and 40 patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government and enterprise clients across multiple industries. Key sectors served include: construction and engineering (major projects like Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, airports), manufacturing, logistics, energy, healthcare, and education. The company serves approximately 500 major engineering projects and focuses on large enterprise clients requiring digital transformation solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with strategic focus on key regions including the Yangtze River Delta integration area, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area. Operations span four major regions: North China, East China, South China, and Southwest China. The company also has a subsidiary in Hong Kong (Horde Software Technology Group Limited) for international business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at the midstream to downstream positions in the digital technology supply chain. It develops and provides software/hardware products and digital solutions to end-user enterprises and government clients. The company also engages in hardware resale and distribution of third-party products alongside its proprietary offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Deepening self-developed software and hardware integration capabilities; (2) Expanding cloud-based digital infrastructure products; (3) Developing industry-specific digital transformation solutions; (4) Strengthening autonomous server design and manufacturing; (5) Advancing BIM and CIM applications; (6) Investing in AI and big data technologies for intelligent platform development. R&D focuses on cloud computing, data management, and industry-specific digital solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) Product sales - software and hardware products sold at one point in time; (2) Service revenue - recognized over time including BIM/CIM digital services, platform customization development, and technical consulting; (3) Cloud services and platform subscriptions; (4) System integration and IT solutions. Revenue recognition depends on contract type and fulfillment method.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading provider of digital infrastructure and intelligent solutions for industry digital transformation. It competes with software and IT service companies offering similar BIM, cloud computing, and digital transformation solutions. The company differentiates through: extensive experience on major national projects, comprehensive solution offerings combining hardware and software, strong R&D capabilities, and deep industry understanding.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2024 revenue was 258.5 million yuan (up 37.45% YoY from 188.1 million yuan in 2023). However, the company reported a net loss of 125.0 million yuan in 2024 (compared to 126.5 million yuan loss in 2023). Total assets declined to 379.0 million yuan from 524.7 million yuan. The company is in a growth phase with expanding revenue but currently unprofitable due to asset impairment charges and equity incentive expenses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's differentiation includes: (1) Comprehensive digital transformation solutions combining software, hardware, and services; (2) Proven track record on major national infrastructure projects (Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, airports, etc.); (3) Self-developed autonomous software and hardware products with intellectual property protection; (4) Deep industry expertise in construction, engineering, and enterprise digital transformation; (5) Integrated cloud-based collaboration platforms reducing project costs and improving efficiency; (6) End-to-end service from digital infrastructure tools to complete industry solutions.
